problem.statement: Should Brightwork launch Dispatch Copilot in Q2 2027, and how should it be packaged and priced to lift net revenue retention from 101% to 105% by 2028 with gross margin at or above 75%?
problem.decision_maker: CEO and executive team, approving the 2027 plan
success_criteria: Company gross margin stays at or above 75%
The 14-engineer build and the two-quarter mobile delay earn their keep
problem.accuracy: Order of magnitude (about ±25%); every figure comes from the briefing pack

one_day_answer.situation: Brightwork has built Dispatch Copilot, the beta shows productivity gains, and Routewise already bundles AI scheduling in its Pro plan
one_day_answer.complication: The $149 add-on case rests on survey intent about three times paid take-up, and the launch delays the mobile rewrite customers rank first
one_day_answer.resolution: Launch in Q2 2027 inside a per-seat Pro tier with a usage allowance, plan on about $2.9M of new ARR, and restart the mobile rewrite in Q3
